title: NASA to Stream SpaceX Crew-12 Return, Splashdown Live
text: NASA and SpaceX are targeting no earlier than 8:05 a.m. EDT, Wednesday, Oct. 7, for the undocking of the agency’s SpaceX Crew-12 mission from the International Space Station, pending weather conditions. An Oct. 7 undock puts NASA astronauts Jessica Meir and Jack Hathaway, ESA (European Space Agency) astronaut Sophie Adenot, and Roscosmos cosmonaut Andrey Fedyaev […]

zhTitle: NASA 將直播 SpaceX Crew-12 的返航與溅落
zh: NASA 和 SpaceX 目標是在東部時間 10 月 7 日星期三上午 8:05 之後進行本機構的 SpaceX Crew-12 任務從國際太空站的對接分離，具體時間依天氣條件而定。10 月 7 日的分離將使 NASA 太空人 Jessica Meir 和 Jack Hathaway、ESA（歐洲太空總署）太空人 Sophie Adenot，以及俄羅斯太空總署（Roscosmos）宇航員 Andrey Fedyaev […]
